Resolves #19166

The Portal's content generators, its SEO routes and the release analyzer read the corpus and the release notes from declared roots. The Portal fetches both from bases in its `neo-config.json`. Since #19322 deleted the mirror, every engine-side run of these scripts read an absent tree, and a dev checkout's Portal fetched bodies from paths that no longer existed.

- **Inputs.** `tickets.mjs`, `pulls.mjs`, `discussions.mjs`, `seo/generate.mjs` and `analyzeClosedSinceRelease.mjs` take a required `--corpus-root`. `release.mjs` and the SEO release routes take `--release-notes`, which `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` defaults to the engine's `.github/RELEASE_NOTES`. A root that is missing, absent or not a directory fails naming its flag before any builder runs (`buildScripts/util/contentRoot.mjs`).
- **Paths.** `contentDir` and the release `path` are relative to their own root. The Portal resolves them against `corpusBasePath` (`resources/content/`, where a developer serves a corpus checkout) and `releaseNotesBasePath` (`.github/RELEASE_NOTES/`).
- **Tracked indexes.** A mechanical rewrite of the six files that carried the prefix: `contentDir` loses `resources/content/`, and `releases.json` points at the flat authored notes. Three ticket titles that mention the path are left alone.
- **Guard.** The baseline keeps one row, `check-content-logical-identity.mjs`.

Evidence: L3 (the dev-server Portal rendering bodies from the declared bases on local Chromium; the generators run on a real corpus copy) → L3 required (AC-2 is a rendered body). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline pr-body and the engine CI ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: arms in `TicketIndex.spec`, `PortalContentIndexes.spec`, `RebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.spec` and `seo/Generate.spec` fail naming the flag without a root. `RebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.spec` also rejects a regular file as either root before any builder or write, with a valid-directory control. "Same index as today" was checked outside CI: `dev`'s generators and this branch's, run on one corpus copy (`github-content-sync` at `3894176`), wrote the same 1,170 files. All are equal once the old prefix is stripped; the 6 that differ raw are the prefixed ones (2,467 fields). |
| AC-2 | Outside CI: the dev server renders ticket 17800 (`issues/chunk-19`) and ticket 14557 (`archive/issues/v13.1.0/chunk-8`), with only those two files placed under `resources/content/`. It also renders release 13.1.0 from `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/`. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `check-content-root-derivations` passes with one baselined literal. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Release notes are folded in, per Vega's comment: `--release-notes`, defaulting to the authored `.github/RELEASE_NOTES` in an engine checkout.
- `prepare.mjs` rebuilds only the release and label indexes. The engine holds no corpus, and a sitemap built without one drops every conversation route. The deploy rebuilds the rest from its declared corpus.
- The dev server serves `.github/RELEASE_NOTES` at its own path. Without that entry the release body 404'd in the browser, because the static server serves no dot-directory. Allowing dotfiles globally would serve `.git` too.
- The sitemap's git `lastmod` lookup skips paths outside the work tree. One such path from an external corpus root fails its whole 200-path `git log` chunk, engine routes included.
- `releases.json` is flattened, not regenerated. Regenerating it adds the unreleased 13.2 note, dated at the file's creation time. Notes from 13.2 on carry no `publishedAt`: out of scope, noted in a defect-note.

## Test Evidence
- Red on `dev` source: 14 arms fail (the 8 new ones, plus the 6 updated ones that now pass a root). All pass here.
- Browser: `/.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.1.0.md` returned 404 before the dev-server entry and 200 after; `/.git/config` stays 404.

- [x] neomjs/pages passes `--corpus-root resources/content --release-notes resources/content/release-notes` in step 7 and sets `releaseNotesBasePath` to `resources/content/release-notes/` before the 13.2 deploy: neomjs/pages#14, merged as `8ef13f75`. The deployed read is owned on #17416.
- [x] neomjs/neo-agent-brain's `SyncService` stops deriving Portal indexes and SEO, so its engine pin can move past this commit: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#889, merged as `a38f2329`. Called as it is today, `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo` fails naming `--corpus-root`, and Brain CI stubs that call, so a pin move would stay green until a plane ran the sync. Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#888, a sub of #459.
